notes: Front: 'WhistlePig PiggyBack', 'SMALL BATCH', '100% RYE WHISKEY', '48.28 ALC/VOL', '96.56 PROOF', '750 ML', 'Aged 6 Years In New American Oak Barrels', 'Farm and Distillery'. Back: 'PiggyBack 100% Rye Whiskey', 'Give it 100' with QR code, Government Warning, 'DISTILLED IN VT & CANADA / BOTTLED BY WHISTLEPIG WHISKEY CO., MINEVILLE, NY'. Interesting case: label states co-origin of VT and Canada. 'PiggyBack' is the product/fanciful name, 'WhistlePig' is the brand.
